title: docs(permissions): system-context.mdx is a hand-written per-site census of every isSystem read, edited 9 times in 30 days and held by a gate whose --fix is retired — generate it like tenant-audit-census.mdx
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:devx` (docs gates) with `domain:server` for the symbol list.

**Measured:** `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` holds `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` — one `path#symbol` row per `isSystem` read plus a headline count — to the code; its `--fix` is RETIRED ("refuses, exit 2 — nothing on the page is generated"), so every move of a symbol is a hand edit: 9 commits to the page in 30 days. Its sibling `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` is generated by `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` and only drift-checked.

**Wanted:** generate the census table and the count from the tree (the tenant-audit pattern, `--write` + drift check), keeping the page's hand-written explanatory prose above the table; or, if the maintainer's reading is that the page is not read, retire the table and the gate and keep the prose. The lane proposes which on the PR. **Acceptance:** a symbol move needs no hand edit of the table; `check-system-context-census` is either a drift check over generated output or gone. **Size:** S. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
